Short side is always 1080, so the brand's typeScale applies unchanged. `safe` = platform UI zones (px from each edge) that text must avoid; the brand's spacing.safeArea is used where it is larger. `duration` = default total video length in seconds (the user can ask for any other length; it is stored in meta.json → duration). `sceneSeconds` = the approximate length of one scene for readability.
